note: Toast menu item GUID (items) or normalized item name (names) -> tower slot(s). Built from the Toast wine menu. A bottle shows as a pull and comes off the count; a glass comes off the count by its pour. An entry can say "kind": "glass" or "bottle" and "oz" for its pour; otherwise item and modifier names decide ("5 oz", "glass", "btg", "bottle"). pourOz is the house pour, bottleOz a 750.
